title: Map: Initial Overflights of China, January–March 1962 (Missions GRC 100–106)
description: Map titled "Initial Overflights of China, January - March 1962" with a legend for Mission GRC 100 (13 January 1962), GRC 102 (23 February 1962), GRC 104 (13 March 1962) and GRC 106 (26 March 1962). Looping flight tracks originate at T'ao-yuan Airfield, Taiwan, and cross mainland China to points including Shuangchengtzu, Lan-chou, Chiang-yu, K'un-ming, Ch'ang-sha, Wu-ch'ang, Nanking and Shanghai. Mongolia, Manchuria, Korea, Japan and Indochina are also labeled; marked Secret NOFORN.
